resources.string: On a TV or XR glasses the stream automatically matches that screen\'s resolution and refresh rate. To customise each screen, create settings profiles named \"TV\", \"Glasses\" or \"Tablet\" – they switch on by themselves when you stream on that screen.
Sets the bitrate from the resolution and frame rate being streamed (overrides the bitrate slider)
How much extra bitrate to use. High is best for most home Wi-Fi 6/7 networks
